# Widgets

As an RN app residing on the SeaTalk platform, you are strongly encouraged to adopt to use these widgets whenever applicable.

# Alert

namespace Alert

### Method

```javascript
show(title: string, subtitle: string, primaryAction: IAlertAction, secondaryAction?: IAlertAction, inputConfig?: IAlertTextInputConfig) Copy
```

### Description

Shows a SeaTalk alert dialog.

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|title|No|string|Title of the alert dialog|
|subtitle|No|string|Message of the alert dialog|
|primaryAction|Yes|IAlertAction|First action button of the dialog, typically 'OK', 'Confirm'.|
|secondaryAction|No|IAlertAction|Second action button of the dialog, typically 'Cancel'. undefined means there is not second button. Default value is undefined.|
|inputConfig|No|IAlertTextInputConfig|Config for text inputs. Defaults to undefined, meaning no input box for the alert dialog.|

## interface IAlertAction

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|title|Yes|string|Title of the action button|
|style|Yes|AlertActionStyle|'normal' \| 'success' \| 'critical'|
|color|No|string|Color of the action button, higher priority than style. e.g. #ff00ee|
|callback|No|(input: string \| undefined) => void|Callback when the button is tapped. 1. When inputConfig is undefined (no input box), the input will also be undefined for the callback. 2. When there is an input box, the content user typed in the input box will be passed to the callback.|

### Color templates for iOS and Android

|System|normal|critical|success|
|---|---|---|---|
|iOS|#000D26|#F5222D|#1B92F5|
|Android|#1B92F5|#F5222D|#1B92F5|

## interface IAlertTextInputConfig

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|placeholder|No|string|String that will be used as the placeholder|
|prefilledText|No|string|String that will be used as prefilled text. If both placeholder and prefilledText are provided, prefilledText will be visible first.|
|maxInputLength|No|number|Determines the max input length (inclusive) of the input string. If prefilledText is provided, it will be truncated as needed.|

## Example

```javascript
Alert.show(
    'This is an alert title',
    'This is an alert subtitle',
    {
        title: 'Confirm',
        style: 'normal',
        color: 'darkgreen',
    },
    {
        title: 'Cancel',
        style: 'critical',
        color: '#ff0000',
    }
); Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

```javascript
Alert.show(
    'This is an alert title',
    'This is an alert subtitle',
    {
        title: 'Confirm',
        style: 'normal',
        callback: (input) => {
            logger.info(input);
        },
    },
    {
        title: 'Cancel',
        style: 'critical',
    },
    {
        placeholder: 'Customizable placeholder',
    }
); Copy
```

# HUD

This component provides capability to show progress HUD and success/failure HUD that auto-dismiss itself on an RN page.There are three types of HUD provided by the SDK.

|Loading|Success|Error|
|---|---|---|
|![](data:image/png;base64,)|![](data:image/png;base64,)|![](data:image/png;base64,)|

## namespace HUD

### Methods

|Method|Description|
|---|---|
|hudShowLoading()|Shows a loading hud|
|hudShowSuccess(text: string)|Shows a success HUD with the given text. If there's already a loading HUD being shown, it will hide the loading HUD before showing the success HUD.|
|hudShowError(text: string)|Shows an error HUD with the given text. If there's already a loading HUD being shown, it will hide the loading HUD before showing the error HUD.|
|hudHide()|Hides the current hud if it's showing. If no hud is showing, it will result in no-op.|

# Navigation Bar

Our SDK provides a set of SeaTalk style navigation bars to keep your RN app consistent with the SeaTalk app.The Nav bars provided by the SDK are highly customizable. It's split into three sections, namely, the left button, title, and the right buttons. Each section is**configurable**independently.It also takes care of the**safe area**automatically so as to prevent your content being cut off.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

To render a page as shown above, what you need is simply.

```javascript
<NavBarPage
    title={TXT('nav-title')}
    backButtonType="cancel"
    menuItems={[
        {
            title: 'Edit',
            callback: () => {
                this.onPressEditNavBarMenu();
            },
        },
        {
            icon: require('./close.png'),
            callback: () => {
                this.onPressCloseNavBarMenu();
            },
        },
    ]}
    onBackButtonTapped={() => {
        logger.info('Back button tapped');
        Navigator.pop();
    }}
>
// render your own page here
</NavBarPage> Copy
```

## component NavBarPage

This is a wrapper component to render you content under a navigation bar. As shown in the code above, most likely you will be rendering this component as your page component's root component.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|title|string|Title of the navigation bar.|
|backButtonType|'back' \| 'close' \| 'cancel'|Back button is the button on the left of the navigation bar. We only support three types of back buttons as of now. We do not encourage putting functional menu items on the left side, as it's mainly for navigation purpose.|
|menuItems|INavBarMenuItem\[\]|Menu items represent buttons on the right of the navigation bar. Each menu item can either be icon-type (INavBarMenuIconItem) or text-type (INavBarMenuTextItem). See below for more details. Order in which the buttons are shown will follow the order of the array. NOTE: We support showing at most two menu items .|
|buttonTintColor|string|Tint color to be applied to all the buttons (including the back button and the menu item buttons). Default to undefined, thus using the default color.|
|onBackButtonTapped|() => void|Callback for when back button is tapped. Default to calling Navigator.pop().|

## interface ITitleProps

Renders a text button on the menu item area. Upon tapping the callback is invoked.

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|title|Yes|string|Title of the button|
|callback|Yes|() => void|Callback to be invoked when user taps the button|

## interface INavBarMenuIconItem

Renders an icon on the menu item area. Upon tapping the callback is invoked.

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|icon|Yes|ImageSourcePropType|The image source type provided by the react-native package. Can be a URI or a required source.|
|callback|Yes|() => void|Callback to be invoked when user taps the button.|

## interface INavBarMenuTextItem

Renders a text button on the menu item area. Upon tapping the callback is invoked.

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|icon|Yes|string|Title of the button|
|callback|Yes|() => void|Callback to be invoked when user taps the button.|

# Buttons

We provide some commonly used buttons for you to quickly build your app with SeaTalk consistency.

## component SolidButton

### Properties

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|title|Yes|string|Title of the button|
|enabled|No|Boolean|Whether this button is enabled and thus can be pressed. Default to true.|
|critical|No|Boolean|Whether this button is rendered as a critical button. Usually for irreversible/destruction actions like deleting something. Default to false.|
|backgroundStyle|No|ViewStyle|Additional styles to further customise the button. Default to undefined.|
|titleStyle|No|TextStyle|Additional styles for further costomise the title. Default to undefined.|
|onPress|Yes|() => void|Callback|

# Calendar Picker

## module CalendarPicker

### Method

```javascript
selectDates(config: CalendarConfig): Promise<SelectDateResult>
 Copy
```

### Description

Launches a new page to select date(s) according to the config.

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|config|Yes|CalendarConfig|Configuration of the calendar picker to be launched|

### type CalendarConfig

```javascript
{
    type: 'SingleDate',
        initialSelection ?: [{ date: string }],
        selectableDateStart ?: { date: string },
        selectableDateEnd ?: { date: string }
} | {
    type: 'DateRange',
    initialSelection?: [{ date: string }, { date: string }],
    selectableDateStart?: { date: string },
    selectableDateEnd?: { date: string }
} | {
    type: 'DateRangeWithHalfDay',
    initialSelection?: [{ date: string, period: HalfDay }, { date: string, period: HalfDay }],
    selectableDateStart?: { date: string },
    selectableDateEnd?: { date: string }
} Copy
```

|Type|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|type|Yes|SelectionType = 'SingleDate' \| 'DateRange' \| 'DateRangeWithHalfDay'|The type of the calendar picker|
|initialSelection|No|Type depends on value of type date: string , should be in the format of 'DD-MM-YYYY' , e.g. 20-08-2020 , in Gregorian Calendar HalfDay = 'AM' \| 'PM'|- The initial selection of date(s) when the calendar picker is launched - Omitting this parameter results in no dates being selected when the calendar picker is launched|
|selectableDateStart|No|date: string , should be in the format of 'DD-MM-YYYY' , e.g. 20-08-2020 , in Gregorian Calendar|- The earliest date that is selectable on the calendar picker.|
|selectableDateEnd|No|date: string , should be in the format of 'DD-MM-YYYY' , e.g. 20-08-2020 , in Gregorian Calendar|- The latest date that is selectable on the calendar picker.|

### type SelectDateResult

```javascript
{
    wasCancelled: true
} | {
    wasCancelled: false,
    selectedDates: Array < { date: string } > | Array < { date: string, period: HalfDay } >
} Copy
```

|Type|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|wasCancelled|Yes|Boolean|Whether the calendar picker is cancelled without selecting any date|
|selectedDates|No (exists when wasCancelled === false )|Array<{ date: string }> \| Array<{ date: string, period: HalfDay }> date: string , in the format of 'DD-MM-YYYY' , .e.g. 20-08-2020 . In Gregorian Calendar. HalfDay = 'AM' \| 'PM'|Array of the selections of dates by user. If type in CalendarConfig is 'DateRangeWithHalfDay' , period will exist in each of the element.|

### type SelectionType

|Type|
|---|
|'SingleDate' \| 'DateRange' \| 'DateRangeWithHalfDay'|

### type HalfDay

|Type|
|---|
|'AM' \| 'PM'|

## Samples

### Single Date

```javascript
import { CalendarPicker } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets';

const result = await CalendarPicker.selectDates({ type: 'SingleDate' });
console.log(JSON.stringify(result));

// Log// {"selectedDates":[{"date":"07-08-2020"}],"wasCancelled":false} Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### Date Range

```javascript
import { CalendarPicker } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets';

const result = await CalendarPicker.selectDates({ type: 'DateRange' });
console.log(JSON.stringify(result));

// Log// {"selectedDates":[{"date":"07-08-2020"},{"date":"14-08-2020"}],"wasCancelled":false} Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### Date Range With Half Day

```javascript
import { CalendarPicker } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets';

const result = await CalendarPicker.selectDates({
    type: 'DateRangeWithHalfDay',
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(result));

// Log
// {"selectedDates":[{"date":"07-08-2020","period":"AM"},{"date":"14-08-2020","period":"PM"}],"wasCancelled":false} Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### Date Range With Half Day - Initial Selection Defined

```javascript
import { CalendarPicker } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets';

const result = await CalendarPicker.selectDates({
    type: 'DateRangeWithHalfDay',
    initialSelection: [
        { date: '06-08-2020', period: 'AM' },
        { date: '06-08-2020', period: 'PM' },
    ],
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(result));

// Log
// {"selectedDates":[{"date":"06-08-2020","period":"AM"},{"date":"06-08-2020","period":"PM"}],"wasCancelled":false} Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### Date Range With Half Day - Selectable Date Range Defined

```javascript
import { CalendarPicker } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets';

const result = await CalendarPicker.selectDates({
    type: 'DateRangeWithHalfDay',
    initialSelection: [
        { date: '06-08-2020', period: 'AM' },
        { date: '06-08-2020', period: 'PM' },
    ],
    selectableDateStart: { date: '05-08-2020' },
    selectableDateEnd: { date: '01-09-2020' },
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(result));

// Log
// {"selectedDates":[{"date":"06-08-2020","period":"AM"},{"date":"06-08-2020","period":"PM"}],"wasCancelled":false} Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

# Image Picker (Depreciated)

module CalendarPicker

## Method

```javascript
selectImages(maxNumberOfImages: number): Promise<ImagePickerResult> Copy
```

### Description

Launches a new page to select the images from the on device album. When the returned`Promise`is rejected, it will be rejected with an`ImagePickerError`.Note: The operations on the native side can be time-consuming. It's recommended that user show a progress loading using`HUD.hudShowLoading()`

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|maxNumberOfImages|Yes|number|Integer that specifies how many images can be selected at most at the same time|

### type ImagePickerResult

```javascript
{
    wasCancelled: false,
        images: ImageInfo[]
} | {
    wasCancelled: true
} Copy
```

|Type|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|wasCancelled|Yes|Boolean|Whether the image picker is cancelled without selecting any image|
|images|No (exists when wasCancelled === false )|ImageInfo\[\]|Array of images with their information|

### interface ImageInfo

```javascript
interface ImageInfo {
    fileUri: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
} Copy
```

|Type|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|fileUrl|Yes|string|URI that represents the local file path of the selected image. Always starts with file:// . Note: Please DO NOT persist this URI since user can delete the underlying file after this session.|
|width|Yes|number|Width of the image in number of pixels|
|height|Yes|number|Height of the image in number of pixels|

### interface ImagePickerError

```javascript
interface ImagePickerError {
    code: string;
    message?: string | null;
} Copy
```

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|code|Yes|string|Error code. Should be either ImagePickerError.SDK\_ERROR or ImagePickerError.NO\_PERMISSION|
|message|No|string \| null \| undefined|Message describing this error|

### object ImagePickerError

```javascript
const ImagePickerError = {
    SDK_ERROR: '1',
    NO_PERMISSION: '2',
}; Copy
```

|Name|Code|Description|
|---|---|---|
|SDK\_ERROR|1|Error code meaning there is something wrong with the SDK or the native side.|
|message|2|Error code meaning the user has rejected the permission request to fetch the image storage.|

## Samples

```javascript
import { ImagePicker, ImagePickerError } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets';

async function pickImages() {
    try {
        const result = await ImagePicker.selectImages(5);
        if (!result.wasCancelled) {
            console.log(`success: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
        } else {
            console.log('cancelled');
        }
    } catch (error) {
        switch (error.code) {
            case ImagePickerError.SDK_ERROR: {
                console.error(`SDK_ERROR, ${error.message}`);
                break;
            }
            case ImagePickerError.NO_PERMISSION: {
                console.error(`NO_PERMISSION, ${error.message}`);
                break;
            }
            default: {
                console.error(`Unknown error, ${JSON.stringify(error)}`);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Log
// {"images":[{"fileUri":"file:///storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.seagroup.seatalk/cache/image/c6f94e44f7c50610901ac2d0472f19e9.jpg","height":1280,"width":960},{"fileUri":"file:///storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.seagroup.seatalk/cache/image/ddc1152fae9525f0f5cc36af21af9299.jpg","height":1280,"width":960}],"wasCancelled":false} Copy
```

# New Image Picker (Preferred)

## function selectImagesFiles

```javascript
selectImagesFiles(maxNumberOfImages: number): Promise<ImagePickerFileResult> Copy
```

### Description

Launches a new page to select the images from the on device album. When the returned`Promise`is rejected, it will be rejected with an`ImagePickerError`**NOTE**: The operations on the native side can be time-consuming. It's recommended that user show a progress loading using HUD.hudShowLoading()

### Parameters

|Name|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|maxNumberOfImages|Yes|number|Integer that specifies how many images can be selected at most at the same time|

## type ImagePickerFileResult

### Description

In order to accommodate images that have been stored locally and increase cohesion with other File based APIs provided by this SDK, we introduce a new type to incorporate the`FileInfo`type.

```javascript
{
    wasCancelled: false,
        images: ImageFileInfo[]
} | {
    wasCancelled: true
} Copy
```

|Type|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|wasCancelled|Yes|Boolean|Whether the image picker is cancelled without selecting any image|
|images|No (exists when wasCancelled === false )|ImageFileInfo\[\]|Array of images with their information|

## interface ImageInfo

```javascript
interface ImageFileInfo {
    fileInfo: FileInfo;
    width: number;
    height: number;
} Copy
```

### Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|fileInfo|FileInfo|FileInfo containing the info to access this image locally|
|width|number|Width of the image in number of pixels|
|height|number|Height of the image in number of pixels|

## interface ImagePickerError

```javascript
interface ImagePickerError {
    code: string;
    message?: string | null;
} Copy
```

### Parameters

|Parameter|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|code|string|Error code|
|message|string / null / undefined|Message describing this error|

## object ImagePickerError

```javascript
const ImagePickerError = {
    SDK_ERROR: '1',
    NO_PERMISSION: '2',
    MAX_SIZE_EXCEEDED: '3',
}; Copy
```

### Parameters

||value|Description|
|---|---|---|
|SDK\_ERROR|'1'|Error code meaning there is something wrong with the SDK or the native side.|
|NO\_PERMISSION|'2'|Error code meaning the user has rejected the permission request to fetch the image storage.|
|MAX\_SIZE\_EXCEEDED|'3'|Error code meaning that image selected/captured exceeded the provided maxFileSize attribute.|

### Sample

```javascript
import { ImagePicker, ImagePickerError } from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-widgets'async onPressImageFilePicker(): Promise < void> {
    HUD.hudShowLoading();
    try {
        const result = await (await sdkClient).picker.selectImagesFiles(5);
        HUD.hudHide();
        if(!result.wasCancelled) {
        logger.info(`onPressImageFilePicker success: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
        const images = await Promise.all(
            result.images.map(async (image) => ({
                fileUri: await (await sdkClient).fileSystem.fileManager.getFullURI(
                    image.fileInfo
                ),
                width: image.width,
                height: image.height,
            }))
        );
        await(await sdkClient).navigator.push('/imageviewer', {
            images: images,
        });
    } else {
        HUD.hudShowError('Cancelled');
        logger.info('onPressImageFilePicker cancelled');
    }
} catch (error) {
    HUD.hudHide();
    logger.error(error);
    switch (error.code) {
        case ImagePickerError.SDK_ERROR: {
            HUD.hudShowError(`ImageFilePicker: SDK_ERROR, ${error.message}`);
            break;
        }
        case ImagePickerError.NO_PERMISSION: {
            HUD.hudShowError(`ImageFilePicker: NO_PERMISSION, ${error.message}`);
            break;
        }
        default:
            HUD.hudShowError(`ImageFilePicker: ${error.code}, ${error.message}`);
    }
}
    } Copy
```
